just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on Gb in Daramad Qarayi. The line peaks at Gb4 (374.3 Hz) at 0:08.2. It closes on Db4, not the tonic (Gb3 → Ds4 → Ds4 → Ds4 → Ds4 → Db4).

flags: tonic B set in the catalog (Afshari's finalis B (249.3 Hz): the suite's pitch set fits Afshari from it (0, 204, 345, 499, 704, 854/907, 990 cents) and two of its eight tracks voted it.
